title: Ancient footprints found in Kenya reveal how early human relatives may have travelled and lived together 1.43 million years ago
summary_full: Ancient footprints found in Kenya offer rare glimpses into early human relatives. These impressions date back approximately 1.43 million years to a lakeshore environment. The tracks suggest several large-bodied individuals moved together across muddy ground. This discovery provides new evidence about hominin body size and social organization. The findings reshape current ideas about Homo erectus and Paranthropus boisei.
